# S8

> The unified JAVA stack. Server, front, databases, and orchestration — already assembled.

S8 (Stack8) is a unified JAVA runtime and application stack. It abstracts the web server (HTTP/2, TLS), request mapping, the thread model, databases, and the front/back API so a small team can ship rich SaaS in one language and one process.

Site: https://stack8.tech
Docs: https://stack8.tech/docs/
This file: https://stack8.tech/llms.txt

If you are an AI coding agent, treat this file as canonical orientation, then follow the linked docs for signatures.

## Mission

Collapse the distance between an idea and a running product. S8 exists so you can ship rich SaaS in one language and one process — Spring Boot, four steps ahead.

## Current names (do not use stale ones)

- Module: `com.s8.meta.api` (not `com.s8.api`)
- Flow: `S8SyncFlow` (not `S8AsyncFlow`)
- Entry: `S8.WEB_SERVER_FACTORY` and `S8.SCRIPT_RUNNER_FACTORY` (not `S8.FACTORY`)
- Front package: `com.s8.meta.api.front` (not `…web`)
- Flows run on virtual threads. Write straight-line Java. Do not cache a flow.

## How an app is structured

```
main
  └─ S8.WEB_SERVER_FACTORY.createWebServer(configXml, BootClass, params ->
         params.addBootMethod(S8BootMethod.MAIN_BOOT_PAGE, flow -> { ... }))
  └─ server.start()

boot(S8SyncFlow flow)          // virtual thread; live for this request only
  ├─ S8FrontSession front = flow.front()
  ├─ build S8FrontObject graph; outbound fields; inbound methods
  ├─ vertex.expose(0)
  ├─ flow.tables() / spaces() / repositories() / mail() / delegate()
  └─ flow.refresh()
```

## Hello server

```java
import com.s8.meta.api.S8;
import com.s8.meta.api.server.S8BootMethod;
import com.s8.meta.api.server.S8WebServer;

public class LaunchServer {
  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    S8WebServer server = S8.WEB_SERVER_FACTORY.createWebServer(
        "/path/to/app-config.xml",
        LaunchServer.class,
        params -> params.addBootMethod(
            S8BootMethod.MAIN_BOOT_PAGE, AppBoot.INSTANCE));
    server.start();
  }
}
```

## Hello front

```java
public final class AppBoot implements S8BootMethod {
  static final AppBoot INSTANCE = new AppBoot();
  @Override
  public void boot(S8SyncFlow flow) throws Exception {
    HomeScreen screen = new HomeScreen(flow.front());
    screen.setTitle("Hello S8");
    screen.vertex.expose(0);
    flow.refresh();
  }
}

@S8ObjectType(name = "app.HomeScreen")
class HomeScreen extends S8FrontObject {
  HomeScreen(S8FrontSession front) {
    super(front, "app.HomeScreen");
  }
  void setTitle(String title) {
    vertex.outbound().setStringUTF8Field("title", title);
  }
}
```

Inbound functions receive `(S8SyncFlow flow, …)` and you call `flow.refresh()`.
Inbound lambdas receive only the argument; the wrapper refreshes for you.

## S8SyncFlow

Interface `com.s8.meta.api.flow.S8SyncFlow`. Short-lived. Virtual-threaded.

Constants: `CREATE_SPACE_IF_NOT_PRESENT`, `SAVE_IMMEDIATELY_AFTER`, `SHOULD_NOT_OVERRIDE`, `HEAD_VERSION = -0x62L`.

Methods:
- `S8User getMe()` / `void setMe(S8User)` / `String getMySpaceId()`
- `S8FrontSession front()`
- `TablesDB tables()`
- `SpacesDB spaces()`
- `RepositoriesDB repositories()`
- `MailManager mail()`
- `DelegatedRunner delegate()`
- `void sendResponse(SendExtResponseS8Request)`
- `void deliver(int load, S8WebResourceGenerator)`
- `void refresh()`

## Persistence

Tables (`TablesDB`): flash key/value of `RowS8Object`, annotated `@S8RowType`. `createTable`, `getRow`, `putRow`, `selectRows`.

Spaces (`SpacesDB`): object-graph shells. `createSpace`, `exposeSpace`, `accessSpace`. Nodes extend `SpaceS8Object`.

Repositories (`RepositoriesDB`): git-like object repos. `createRepository`, `fork*`, `commitBranch`, `cloneBranch` (often at `HEAD_VERSION`). Nodes extend `RepoS8Object`.

## Annotations

`@S8ObjectType(name, sub)` `@S8Field(name, export)` `@S8Getter` `@S8Setter` `@S8Method` `@S8Param` `@S8RowType(name)` `@S8Serial` `@S8SerialType`.

Wire names are the contract. Do not rename them without a migration.

## Modules (S8-meta-env)

Sibling folders under a stack root. Machine config `/etc/s8-conf.properties`:

```
JAVA_HOME = …
dev.stack = /path/to/git
prod.stack = /path/to/stack
```

Each module: `public static final S8Module MODULE`, `@S8ModuleDescriptor` on `module-info.java`, `build.properties`.

`S8Mode`: DEV (sources) vs PROD (jars). Web sources: `web-sources` in DEV, `web-classes` in PROD.

## Build (S8-meta-build)

`build.properties` keys:
- `module.java` (required) — JPMS name
- `dependencies` — comma-separated **target folder names**, not Java names
- `module.web`, `main`, `author` optional
- `target=` is documentation; the loader uses the directory name

```java
S8BuildContext context = new S8BuildContext(BuildPolicy.FORCE_REBUILD);
new S8StackBuilder(context, "S8-pkgs-ui-aloe").build();
```

Pipeline: forge copy → `javac --module-path` → jar into `prod/TARGET/classes/TARGET.jar` → copy web/static assets.

Policies: `FORCE_REBUILD`, `LAZY_BUILD`. Circular graphs fail after 8192 steps.
